FINANCIAL SUMMARY & CASH FLOW STATEMENT REVIEW

Net cash generated from operating activities for the year ended March 31, 2024 was ₹3,412.50 million as against ₹(2,190.10) million in the previous fiscal year ended March 31, 2023.

Net cash generated from / (used in) investing activities for FY24 stood at ₹(99) Cr compared to ₹(3,411) Cr in FY23. Purchase of property, plant, and equipment accounted for major capital expenditure of ₹2,105.40 million during FY24.

Freight, handling and servicing costs for the year ended March 31, 2024 were ₹59,707.49 million compared to ₹56,694.80 million in FY23, representing a growth of 5.31% driven by expanded hub automation and volume growth across express parcel networks.

Capital commitments remaining to be executed and not provided for as of March 31, 2024 stood at ₹412.10 million.
